title: The canonical single-module union comparison diagram before two-out-of-three
statement: Let p:Y→B be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let B,A be affine and let g:A→B. Let U,V be arbitrary opens of Y, and let N be a quasi-coherent module on U union V, flat over B. Assume StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen(p,g,T) for T=U,V,U intersection V [def-pc-standard-single-flat-counit-presentation-on-open]. Use standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Write a for the canonical union comparison [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map]. Restrict N by literal tensorPullback along Scheme.homOfLE to each member and the overlap and write aU,aV,aUV for their canonical comparisons. There are distinguished triangles in D(O_A) with vertices (domain a, domain aU direct-sum domain aV, domain aUV) and (codomain a, codomain aU direct-sum codomain aV, codomain aUV), and a morphism with components exactly a, biprod.map(aU,aV), aUV. Each of aU,aV,aUV is invertible. No invertibility of a, no bounded union complex, and no factorization at a supplied union complex is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0DJ9, induction diagram; Tag 08BV, arbitrary two-open K-injective Mayer--Vietoris; Tag 08FE, restriction of direct image. Official online pages read 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Restrict N along the open inclusions of U, V and U intersection V into their union. Open restriction is exact and identifies with tensorPullback along these open immersions, so it preserves quasi-coherence and relative flatness. Apply hPU,hPV,hPUV to those three modules. Each presentation supplies a bounded-above termwise-flat complex, its direct-image isomorphism and its pinned counit equation. Bounded-flat K-flatness and counit_isIso_kFlat make the counit invertible. The direct-image isomorphism and the ordinary-pullback isomorphism then show that each of the three literal standardSingleBaseChangeMap arrows aU,aV,aUV is invertible.

Represent N[0] on the union and the ordinary pulled-back module in degree zero on its base change by K-injective complexes with injective terms. Use schemeKInjective_mayerVietoris_presentation for the induced open covers. Localize their short exact complexes using triangleOfSES. Apply the triangulated derived direct-image functors and derived pullback on the source side; transport all vertices by derived direct-image composition and the exact open-restriction identifications. Additivity makes the middle objects precisely aU.left biproduct aV.left and aU.right biproduct aV.right. This constructs the six displayed differentials and their distinguished triangles with no compactness assumption.

Transpose the canonical single-module pullback map under the derived adjunction. Its restriction squares are the naturality squares of the sectionwise adjunction units; their difference gives the second square. The degreewise open counit identity schemeMVUnderivedOpenCounit_square identifies the relevant short exact cover comparison. Naturality of the short-exact boundary, followed by transposition back and shift compatibility, gives the third square. The resulting triangle morphism has first component a.hom. Pasting the canonical pullback and direct-image counits identifies its two member components with aU.hom,aV.hom, so its middle component is biprod.map of these maps; its overlap component is aUV.hom. Package this diagram together with the three isomorphism assertions from step 1.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0DJ9, 08BV and 08FE; C1 isolates the diagram construction from two-out-of-three and the supplied-complex factorization. Arbitrary opens use the general sheaf-module triangle of 08BV, not the quasi-coherent direct-image refinement.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingleFlatCounitUnionTriangles
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hN : N.IsFlatOver ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p))
    (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U)
    (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V)
    (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let a := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g)
    let aU := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (U.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_left) N) g)
    let aV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (V.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_right) N) g)
    let aUV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) N) g)
    ∃ (d₁ : a.left ⟶ aU.left ⊞ aV.left)
      (d₂ : aU.left ⊞ aV.left ⟶ aUV.left)
      (d₃ : aUV.left ⟶ a.left⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (d₁' : a.right ⟶ aU.right ⊞ aV.right)
      (d₂' : aU.right ⊞ aV.right ⟶ aUV.right)
      (d₃' : aUV.right ⟶ a.right⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk d₁ d₂ d₃ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory A) ∧
      Triangle.mk d₁' d₂' d₃' ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory A) ∧
      ∃ φ : Triangle.mk d₁ d₂ d₃ ⟶ Triangle.mk d₁' d₂' d₃',
        φ.hom₁ = a.hom ∧ φ.hom₂ = biprod.map aU.hom aV.hom ∧ φ.hom₃ = aUV.hom ∧
        IsIso aU.hom ∧ IsIso aV.hom ∧ IsIso aUV.hom
